data_fields.name: armour_fail_per_point
data_fields.donor_constant: 19 per adjusted armour and shield penalty point (scale 100)

data_fields.name: power_cap_per_spell
data_fields.donor_constant: per-spell table, e.g. Magic Dart 25, Fireball 200

data_fields.name: mp_cost_per_level
data_fields.donor_constant: cost = spell level; Brilliance halves, rounded up

data_fields.name: miscast_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: 150 on level x level x fail

best_idea: Give every spell one data-driven failure curve (base, caster-stat terms, armour penalty, level table, clamp) and one roll that pays the MP before it, so a heavy caster in armour gets a visible penalty.
decision_why: Keep the armour-penalty-on-casting term, the pay-before-roll order and the miscast severity; replace the three-dice roll and cubic smoothing with one server roll on a simple table, because the donor curve is tuned for turn-based play and a fast mobile fight needs a readable figure.
acceptance: The cast tooltip shows the formula's failure figure (4% for a level-5 spell with skill_power 5000, INT 20, armour penalty 40); a server test with 10,000 seeded rolls lands within 1 point, a failed cast still spends its MP, and a level-5 spell at 100% failure deals 59 miscast units.
